articles.title: North Korea says tested AI-assisted torpedo system
articles.summary: North Korea has reportedly tested a new precision-guided torpedo system, leveraging artificial intelligence for advanced target detection and guidance. This significant development, confirmed by state media, highlights Pyongyang's ongoing efforts to modernize its conventional weaponry with cutting-edge technology. Such advancements in military capabilities carry important implications for regional stability and international defence strategies, warranting close observation by security analysts worldwide.

articles.title: N. Korea tests guided torpedo equipped with AI tech
articles.summary: North Korea test-fired its Cham-2.0 submarine-launched torpedo, featuring advanced AI technology, according to KCNA. This significant development highlights Pyongyang's continuous efforts to modernize its naval warfare capabilities. The involvement of its National Defense Academy and Rocket Industry directorate underscores a strategic push in military research and development, potentially escalating regional security concerns for SSB aspirants to note.

articles.title: Board of Clients 2026
articles.summary: In the late 1990s, Forrester established its first Board of Clients, a group of customers providing advice on acquisitions, research, and product direction. Members served for three yearly meetings. This initiative showcased Forrester's early commitment to integrating direct client feedback into its core business strategy, influencing its market offerings and development path.
